definition.name: GPS_estimator
definition.definition: The Grier-Pashayan-Schaeffer (GPS) estimator: Given n copies of an unknown pure state |psi> in C^d, apply Hayashi's measurement to obtain outcome |v>. Then output the debiased estimator sigma_hat_v = ((d+n)/n)|v><v| - (1/n)I. This is an unbiased estimator: E[sigma_hat_v] = |psi><psi|. The debiasing corrects the inherent shrinkage of Hayashi's algorithm toward the maximally mixed state.
